thread:
elaine.c: Quick question — for the upcoming DP cohort, can we finalize the incentive tiers today? Need to lock messaging for outreach by EOD.
miguel.r: +1 on locking. also we should surface what engineers will commit to re: scope (fixed vs negotiable).
tayler: Proposed tiers in the doc: 1) Early Access (10 seats) — priority support, $3k credit. 2) Feedback Partner (25 seats) — $1k credit + 3x office hours. 3) Watchlist (open) — no credit, access to roadmap threads. Thoughts?
sam.k: Is $3k too high for early access? Some partners expect code-level prioritization; we should be explicit about boundaries.
elaine.c: Good call. We need a short one-liner per tier that we can paste into outreach: commit level, expected weekly feedback hours, and what we promise (SLA/rollout). Keep it one sentence each.
miguel.r: From eng side: we can promise a dedicated weekly sync (30–60m) for Early Access and 2-weekly for Feedback Partner. Code drops only for critical fixes or clear regressions.
tayler: OK — draft one-liners:
- Early Access: "Priority onboarding, dedicated weekly sync, $3k infra credit; scope negotiable with engineering time committed for critical fixes."
- Feedback Partner: "Regular feedback check-ins, $1k credit, product roadmap influence but no guaranteed code delivery."
- Watchlist: "Roadmap visibility and occasional surveys; no SLA or credits."
sam.k: I'm worried 'scope negotiable' reads like we will take feature requests. Maybe: 'scope bounded, engineering time available for critical regressions only.'
elaine.c: Agreed — update wording. Also we need to add a small screening rubric in the outreach to avoid signups that will expect feature work.
ops-bot: New doc created: https://internal.redwood/product/dp-incentives-v2 (created by ops-bot)
miguel.r: Screening rubric (short): 1) Use case fit (high/medium/low), 2) Expected traffic and latency constraints, 3) Security/regulatory needs, 4) Willingness to run weekly feedback AND send transcripts. Pasteable CSV:
```
company,use_case,traffic_estimate,compliance_level,commitment_level
Acme Corp,summarization,50k reqs/mo,none,weekly
FinCo,customer-answers,200k reqs/mo,high,weekly
```
elaine.c: Perfect. Can someone add a sentence about confidentiality / NDA? Some partners want public case studies, others not.
tayler: Add: "We require a mutual NDA for Early Access; case studies only with explicit written consent." Short enough for outreach.
sam.k: One more ask — define exit criteria for partners so they don't feel abandoned once cohort ends. e.g., 90 days of engagement OR 3 milestone feedback wins.
miguel.r: From eng POV, define what counts as "milestone feedback win" — e.g., bug fixed in release, model tuning followed by metric improvement, or a performance tweak landed in runtime.
elaine.c: I'll draft outreach email + Google Form with the CSV screening fields. Target outreach tomorrow morning. Anyone want to review before I send?
tayler: I will. Also recommend we batch invites by region/timezone to make sync scheduling easier.
sam.k: +1. Also suggest we prioritize partners who can provide labelled prompts for evals — that speeds up quality regressions.
elaine.c: Great. I'll update doc and ping y'all in the morning for a 15m review. Thanks! :thumbsup:
